name: Pharmacy ownership, premises and PBS approval
what: Meet state rules on who may own a pharmacy and how premises are registered, and Commonwealth location rules to gain approval to dispense PBS medicines.

layers.who: State pharmacy authority or board (premises and ownership)
Commonwealth health department (PBS approval, location rules)

basis.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
basis.quote: The current anti-competitive regulations on the location of pharmacies, or the requirement (with limited exceptions) that only pharmacists own pharmacies

issues.what: Each state limits pharmacy ownership to pharmacists and caps how many pharmacies one pharmacist may own, with different caps in each state.

evidence.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
evidence.quote: There are also limits in each State (but not the Territories) on how many pharmacies each pharmacist can own. These limits vary by State.
